descriptionChirho: The adjective אָדֹם meaning 'red, ruddy', applied to physical appearance (David's complexion), animals (the red heifer), and objects. All 7 occurrences express the same color sense across masculine singular, feminine singular, and masculine plural inflections. Multilingual evidence is consistent: eng 'red/ruddy', spa 'rojo/rojizo', hin लाल, arb أَحْمَر / حُمْر / أَدُوم, kor 붉은, swa 'wekundu/mwekundu/nyekundu'. The conjunction-prefixed form (S80025 'and ruddy') is a purely syntactic variant.
